# Backtest summary (generated by scripts/run_backtest.py)

Expanding-window rolling origin, 35 cutoffs every 3 months (2017-01 to 2025-07), horizons 1-12, 420 forecasts per model.

## Interval calibration: native vs. online conformal intervals

Native = model-implied bands (statsforecast analytic; LightGBM quantile regression). Conformal = mean +/- empirical quantile of the same model's past absolute errors at the same horizon, using only errors observable at the cutoff (first 8 per horizon = warm-up). Both evaluated on the same forecasts (past the warm-up). The Ensemble has no native intervals. `*_pre2025` = conformal coverage for target months before 2025, i.e. before the 2025-26 default surge.

| model         |   native_cov80 |   native_cov95 |   native_width80 |   conformal_cov80 |   conformal_cov95 |   conformal_width80 |   n |   conformal_cov80_pre2025 |   conformal_cov95_pre2025 |
